strategies.name: TSMOM_LO_INVVOL
strategies.thesis: 12-month price momentum combined with inverse-volatility scaling captures the same edge observed in the academic backtest while avoiding large drawdowns.
strategies.signal_construction: Signal = 12-month cumulative return; Vol = annualized std of daily returns over past 60 days; Weight = 1/Vol; Position = max(Signal,0) * Weight; Rebalance monthly, fully liquidate if Signal ≤ 0.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Existing live emitters use flat equal-weight without volatility scaling, leading to high drawdowns; this variant adds inverse-vol weighting and clips negatives, matching the backtest's long-only edge.
strategies.fail_mode: Regime shift where 12-month momentum loses predictive power (e.g., prolonged sideways markets) causing the inverse-vol scaling to amplify noise.

strategies.name: TSMOM_LS_INVVOL
strategies.thesis: Allowing both long and short exposure to 12-month momentum with inverse-vol scaling doubles the usable signal set and reproduces the Tier-2 backtest performance.
strategies.signal_construction: Signal = 12-month cumulative return; Vol = annualized std of daily returns over past 60 days; Weight = 1/Vol; Position = Signal * Weight (sign retained); Rebalance monthly, cap gross exposure at 100% of capital.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Current dead emitters are long-only and ignore volatility; this variant adds short legs and inverse-vol weighting, directly mirroring the Tier-2 backtest.
strategies.fail_mode: Short-side slippage due to futures contract roll mismatches, especially in commodity curves, which can erode the expected profit factor.

strategies.name: COT_MOM_BIAS
strategies.thesis: Combining trader positioning data (COT) with price momentum filters out false signals and improves risk-adjusted returns.
strategies.signal_construction: Momentum = 12-month cumulative return; COT_bias = month-over-month change in net long % from CFTC COT (commercial + non-commercial); CompositeScore = Momentum * sign(COT_bias); Position = CompositeScore * (1/Vol) where Vol is 60-day realized volatility; Clip negatives to zero for long-only version, retain sign for long-short version; Rebalance monthly.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Live emitters never use COT data; this adds an independent macro-sentiment filter that reduces drawdowns and boosts win-rate.
strategies.fail_mode: COT reports are lagged (monthly) and may miss rapid sentiment shifts, leading to stale bias signals during fast market moves.

strategies.name: MACRO_SEASONAL_MOM
strategies.thesis: Seasonal macro variables (e.g., US Industrial Production YoY) modulate exposure to momentum, preserving upside while curbing downside during weak economic periods.
strategies.signal_construction: Momentum = 12-month cumulative return; Macro = latest YoY change in INDPRO (FRED); ExposureFactor = 1 if Macro > 0 else 0.5; Position = Momentum * ExposureFactor * (1/Vol) with Vol = 60-day realized volatility; Clip negatives to zero (long-only); Rebalance monthly.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Current dead emitters lack any macro conditioning; this strategy introduces a simple economic filter that aligns with the observed low-drawdown long-only edge.
strategies.fail_mode: Macro indicator may lag the market and cause under-allocation during sudden recoveries, reducing upside capture.

killers: futures_dead_emitter_v0 (win-rate 5.9%, PF 0.00) - redundant flat-weight momentum that provides no edge
single_most_important_finding: Live emitters ignore volatility scaling and external sentiment filters, which are the key drivers behind the low-drawdown, high-Sharpe edge seen in the academic backtest.
